title: Can You Delete a Year of Market Data? Machine Unlearning Against Exact Retraining Oracles
abstract: arXiv:2609.26242v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a data license expires, deleting stored records does not remove influence encoded in a trained forecaster. Machine unlearning seeks to remove this influence without retraining. We benchmark temporal unlearning with 3,200 paired references trained on all data and oracles retrained without the requested period. The grid covers five architectures, four rolling folds, five deletable years, and three experimental deletion levels on an S&P 500 volatility panel. The 2020 COVID crisis year produces the largest memorization gap for every architecture. Removing it improves all three deployable models in every fold, with the largest improvement in the 2022 bear market, while the two non-deployable models respond inconsistently. The target for approximate unlearning is the oracle, not low predictive accuracy on the deleted period. In one Transformer cell, an oracle that never trained on 2020 still predicts it at an information coefficient of 0.

translated_title: 你能删除一年的市场数据吗？针对精确重训练预言机的机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 当数据许可到期时，删除存储的记录并不能消除已训练预测模型中所编码的影响。机器遗忘旨在无需重新训练的情况下消除这种影响。我们使用3,200对配对模型对时间维度的遗忘进行基准测试，其中一组在全部数据上训练，另一组作为预言机在不包含所请求时期的重新训练数据上训练。该实验网格在标普500波动率数据面板上涵盖五种架构、四个滚动折叠、五个可删除年份以及三个实验性删除级别。2020年新冠疫情危机年份在每种架构下都产生了最大的记忆差距。删除该年份在所有折叠中都改善了所有三个可部署模型，其中在2022年熊市中的改善最大，而两个不可部署模型的响应则不一致。近似遗忘的目标应当是对齐预言机，而不是在已删除时期上实现低预测准确率。在一个Transformer单元中，从未在2020年数据上训练过的预言机对该年份进行预测时信息系数仍为0。
tldr: 该论文构建了金融时序预测中时间维度机器遗忘的大规模基准（3,200对配对模型），发现删除2020年新冠疫情数据产生最大的记忆差距并改善所有可部署模型，并提出近似遗忘的目标应是对齐精确重训练的预言机，而非仅仅降低在已删除时期上的预测准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a large-scale benchmark of 3,200 paired models for temporal machine unlearning in financial forecasting, showing that deleting the 2020 COVID year produces the largest memorization gap and improves all deployable models, and argues that approximate unlearning should target matching the exact retraining oracle rather than merely degrading predictive accuracy on the deleted period.
